channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Michael Porter Jr | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Michael Porter Jr from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Collin Gillespie on Michael Porter Jr
item.description:
Collin Gillespie:

“Michael Porter Jr. might be the best tough shot maker and workout shooter I have ever seen in my life.”

Collin Gillespie on Michael Porter Jr, Oct 13, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr
item.description:
NBABase: Draymond Green on Michael Porter Jr. admitting he lost motivation after his All-Star snub:

“Because he didn’t finish the year strong, people are just like ‘Oh man, he’s just out there playing on a bad team to make an All-Star game.’Now you’re going to have to play so much better… teams looking to sign him are going to hold this against him in the future.”

Draymond Green on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr, Sep 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Sean Marks on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr
item.description:
Brooklyn Nets GM Sean Marks on Michael Porter Jr extension talks:

“We’ll have those discussions. We’ve got time. There's no immediate hurry right now. We value him a lot. He had a terrific year.”

Sean Marks on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr, Jul 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr
item.description:
Michael Malone on Michael Porter Jr. blaming himself for the Timberwolves' loss:

“I couldn't disagree with Michael more. I don't want Michael putting the series loss on himself.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr, May 23, 2024. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Michael Porter Jr
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Nikola Jokic on Michael Porter Jr:

“Mike loves basketball. He's probably the guy that's thinking about basketball 24/7. He wants to be better every day. That's Mike's best (asset).”

Nikola Jokic on Michael Porter Jr, Nov 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Michael Porter Jr:

“I have zero doubt that he's going to have a very big coming up here that's going to help us win this championship.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr, Jun 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.
